decisions.decision: Use an editorial navy and champagne-gold real-estate system with a generated Da Nang skyline, Dragon Bridge, and ocean-wave emblem; interactions use restrained drawers, quick-view modals, a map/list switch, and a guided finder instead of decorative animation.
decisions.source: User-requested interactive redesign and new logo, 2026-08-25

decisions.decision: Elevate the site into an image-led private-brokerage experience with property-specific three-image galleries, crossfade card previews, an interactive signature collection, refined gold button sweeps, and restrained motion with reduced-motion fallbacks.
decisions.source: User-requested elaborate luxury redesign with many more images, 2026-08-25
